name: Arisaka Miki
source:
The popular school nurse, 
Turns into a lesbian after a trauma of being assaulted by a senior she put her trust in the past.
Loves to bring girls to the infirmary and tease them.
While some part of her is a little forceful, she actually have a calm and friendly personality.
